items.title: Louie Bellson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: we adopted two kids: Dee Dee, when she was four months old, and Tony, who just passed away a couple of months ago. My son.

ctx.x: You had children, you and Pearl?

We found out that she couldn’t have children, so we adopted two kids: Dee Dee, when she was four months old, and Tony, who just passed away a couple of months ago. My son. 51 years old. He got real sick. Dee Dee – that’s [a picture of] Dee Dee up in the corner there – she’s about 42 now. A good singer. She’s like her mother. Then after being married to Pearl for 39 years, I met another gem. I thought after Pearl I was going to not get married again. Just play my drums, write music, tour, write, compose, keep on…
